messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Exporting Shapefiles into DISTANCE
parts:
Dear David, 

I have taken a look at your shapefiles and I think the problem was down to the format of the LinkID in the strata shapefile. I initially got an access error on importing the strata shapefile. Despite this it seemed to have loaded it as it was displayed on the map. When trying to generate a design it hung and when I reloaded the project there were only transects in the first stratum.

Once I amended the LinkID (I deleted it and created a new LinkID column which contained integer values) I had a successful import and it happily generated transects in all three strata.

I shall E-mail the amended shapefile back to you privately and I have added a note about this in the distance for windows help which will be shipped with the Distance 7.5. 

Also for future reference user can note that if you import shapefiles using the import shape wizard then you do no have to add the LinkID yourself as that will happen automatically on import.

Hope this helps,

Kind regards,

Laura
